pages.title: A12. The Underworld Seal
pages.text: $(bold)The Nether is shut. Its portals will not take you until you have used a $(thing)Seal of the Underworld$(n).$(br2)$(li)Four $(thing)Mysterious Shards$(n), four $(thing)Bottled Nether Essence$(n) and a $(thing)Nether Crystal$(n) make one.$(br)$(li)Right-click it to use it. It is used up.

pages.title: Seal of the Underworld
pages.text: $(bold)One shard in each corner, the crystal at its heart.

pages.title: The Shards
pages.text: $(bold)Each corner is found somewhere else, about one time in ten.$(br2)$(li)Top left: abandoned mineshaft chests.$(br)$(li)Top right: witches.$(br)$(li)Bottom left: evokers.$(br)$(li)Bottom right: pillager outpost chests.

pages.title: Crystal and Essence
pages.text: $(bold)$(li)The $(thing)Nether Crystal$(n) is brushed from desert pyramids and trail ruins.$(br)$(li)Kill the undead with an $(thing)obsidian-infused bottle$(n) in your off-hand to bottle their $(thing)essence$(n).$(br)$(li)Now and then a whole seal turns up in ruins or a desert well.

pages.title: On the Ring
pages.text: $(bold)The shards, crystal, bottles and the seal are unlocked at $(l:paths/obsidian)Obsidian$(n), ring 6.$(br2)$(l:paths/nether)Nether$(n), ring 6, cannot be bought until you have used a seal.
